$comment: The one source of the paid tiers. scripts/stripe-catalogue.mjs makes Stripe match this file and audits it; the tenant control plane reads the same limits. Amounts are in cents; a paid price is per seat (quantity = seats). Tiers approved 2026-09-22; the storage add-on (per 10 GB block, quantity = blocks) proposed the same day. secure_links_per_member is each member's own allowance of live secure links; the secure-links add-on (per 50-link pack, quantity = packs, team and business only, approved 2026-10-17) adds 50 links per pack to ONE pool the whole workspace shares (secure_links_pool).

metering.$comment: Approved 2026-09-23 (the owner asked for cost passed through plus a margin; docs/plans/tenant-quotas.md). Until the SDK RelayGate exists the metered quantity is every byte a tenant sends INTO its object (bytes_in): each relayed byte arrives once, and control traffic is small beside it. gb_bytes: a billed GB is 10^9 bytes. max_frame_bytes: one WebSocket message larger than this closes the socket (1009), to protect the 128 MB isolate. flush_seconds: how often an object with open sockets writes its counters to its own storage.

metered.$comment: Approved 2026-09-23. Relayed data beyond a tier's included relay_gb is billed per whole GB through a Stripe Billing Meter at 10 cents/GB: 2x Cloudflare Realtime TURN's list price ($0.05/GB) and at least 16x the tenant object's own relay cost (<= $0.006/GB). One price whichever path carried it, since customers do not choose the path. The margin covers Stripe's fees, the account-wide free TURN allowance running out, and support.
metered.name: Citadel Workspace Relay Overage

meter.display_name: Citadel relay GB beyond the plan

coupons.$comment: Every discount shape Stripe holds (templates), the trial caps, the comp grant shapes, and the public codes. Comp codes themselves are NEVER here (this file is public): they are issued into D1 by the signed admin tool, and a static code may never name an unlimited grant. A dynamic code is an instance of a template or a grant, so the Worker never asks Stripe for a new object (scripts/stripe-catalogue.mjs creates one Stripe coupon per discount template at deploy). trial_caps clamp a trial tenant to free-tier size until its subscription is active. A grant with unlimited: true lifts every usage limit (entitlements v2, null = no limit); its alarm thresholds (null = none) only log and record, they never cut. Checked when it loads: billing/coupons-catalogue.mjs.
